name: Three-Tier Pricing
description: Dark, monochrome three-plan pricing: cards rise from blur, prices count up on a mechanical odometer, checks draw row by row, and one accent marks the pick.

props.name: plans
props.description: Plans in display order: name, audience, whole-number monthly and annual prices, a CTA, an optional lead line and features. Set featured on one.

props.name: saving
props.description: Saving beside the billing toggle; it takes the accent once annual is on.

props.name: footnotes
props.description: Fine print under the plans. Reference a note from a feature with note: 1, 2…; marker and note light up together.

props.name: defaultBilling
props.description: Billing period selected on first render.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: the featured plan's top edge and label dot, and the earned saving.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black or near-white surfaces; both are tuned.
